7746f06a-3d18-4dd9-b63f-fe6220c1ce44.line: 随便对付一口算了，今天不想走远。

3e03f5ba-5d6c-45c1-b332-fcb63df4512f.line: 书到了，顺便把家里松了的柜门修一下。

items.imgPrompt: A pair of gold-rimmed eyeglasses resting on a dark walnut desk next to a closed leather notebook, soft indoor lighting, minimal wear

desc.zh: 戴過幾次，家裡小朋友抱著我的時候總容易蹭歪，換了更輕便的款式，這副閒置出。
desc.zh_cn: 戴过几次，家里小朋友抱着我的时候总容易蹭歪，换了更轻便的款式，这副闲置出。
desc.en: Worn a few times. The little one at home always bumps into them when hugging me, so I switched to a lighter pair.

items.imgPrompt: A dark navy blue silk tie draped neatly over a wooden hanger inside a walk-in closet, slight crease in the middle, warm ambient light

desc.zh: 材質有些偏硬，平時在家裡用起來不夠柔軟親膚，怕勒著人，隨手處理掉。
desc.zh_cn: 材质有些偏硬，平时在家里用起来不够柔软亲肤，怕勒着人，随手处理掉。
desc.en: The material is a bit stiff and not soft enough against the skin for home use. Letting it go cheaply.

items.imgPrompt: An unopened luxury glass bottle of massage oil in a cream gift box on a white marble bathroom counter, soft daylight

desc.zh: 朋友送的禮盒，聞了一下木質調太重，家裡妹妹不喜歡這個味道，還是平時慣用的甜橙味更適合睡前放鬆。
desc.zh_cn: 朋友送的礼盒，闻了一下木质调太重，家里妹妹不喜欢这个味道，还是平时惯用的甜橙味更适合睡前放松。
desc.en: A gift from a friend. The woody scent is too strong and my sister doesn't like it; our usual sweet orange oil is better for bedtime relaxation.

items.imgPrompt: A silver mechanical wristwatch with a black alligator strap sitting in a velvet watch box on a bedside table, pristine condition

desc.zh: 商務場合戴過兩次，錶扣邊緣有些鋒利，抱人的時候容易刮到嬌嫩的皮膚，留著沒用。
desc.zh_cn: 商务场合戴过两次，表扣边缘有些锋利，抱人的时候容易刮到娇嫩的皮肤，留着没用。
desc.en: Worn twice for business. The clasp edge is a bit sharp and might scratch delicate skin when holding someone, so I have no use for it.

items.imgPrompt: A large white plush teddy bear sitting on a beige entryway bench, brand new with tags still attached, natural window light

desc.zh: 合作方送的，太佔床上的空間了。晚上睡覺有我抱著就夠了，不需要多餘的東西。
desc.zh_cn: 合作方送的，太占床上的空间了。晚上睡觉有我抱着就够了，不需要多余的东西。
desc.en: Gift from a business partner. Takes up too much space on the bed. Having me to hold her at night is enough; no extra things needed.
